_doc: Hand-kept input of tools/seaslug_names.py: the guides it reads (guides: kind index, an index page whose each link to a species page named by its scientific name gives that species the link's English name; kind species, one page per species, u a template, its heading giving the English name beside the scientific name it checks), and the names read by hand on public pages (web: the taxon and its rank as tools/seaslugs.json names it, the name, nick true when the page calls it a nickname, the page t and u, the page's own words that give it, the date read; note: a short caveat the app shows beside the name; no u when the source is Pierre's own word, not a page). Pierre, 2026-11-17: every useful source, the specialist ones beside the general ones; every name with its source (rule C2), disagreements to points.json (rule C5). Not read by the app.

guides.t: Florent's Guide to the Indo-Pacific Reefs (Florent Charpin), sea slugs

web.name: Holy grail of nudibranchs
web.words: Due to its strange appearance, the nudibranch has been dubbed the "holy grail of nudibranchs" by underwater photographers.

web.words: When a Japanese diver says "Pikachu," this is the animal. (T. pacifica; the page's row also names Thecacera pikachu, described in 2026)

web.name: Pikachu
web.note: a cousin of the species called Pikachu, T. pacifica and T. pikachu; divers here often call it so too
web.t: Pierre, content editor (what divers around Dauin call it)
web.words: ici c'est celle que les plongeurs ont tendance à appeler Pikachu (Pierre, 2026-11-19 06:58); Ou alors il faut le citer comme un cousin de l'espèce appelée Pikachu? (Pierre, 2026-11-19 14:50). Cousin: T. picta, T. pacifica and T. pikachu are accepted species of the genus Thecacera, Polyceridae, in WoRMS (AphiaIDs 527538, 420618, 1883897, read 2026-11-19). docs/decisions/2026-11-19-pikachu-nickname.md; no page: his word, rule C2
